findings.summary: Test titled for image format accept/reject (ID-18-24, ID-55) only asserts the file input is visible; no file is ever attached, no format error or acceptance is asserted
Test titled for add-button-hides-at-5/reappears-on-removal (ID-19, ID-38, ID-40) only asserts the file input is visible; comment admits the real test was never written

Server Action never checks input.images.length against IMAGE_MAX, contradicting the file's own comment that every check re-runs server-side; allows unbounded Storage writes per submission via direct action invocation

Duplicate hashtagIds are not deduped before insert; the batched kudos_hashtags insert fails atomically on the join table's primary key while the parent kudos row (already inserted in a separate call) is not rolled back, leaving an orphaned <1-hashtag row
